title: Correct distance expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be x = vt - (mv³)/(2P).

title: Correct radius expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be r = v²/(g tan θ).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem, relating the net work (Pt - fx) to the change in kinetic energy (½mv²).

title: Force balance on banked curve
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve forces on the banked track, showing the centripetal force is provided by the horizontal component of the normal force (mg tan θ).

title: Constant power and force relation
description: Important: The solution must identify that at maximum speed v, the traction force equals the resistance force, both equal to P/v.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to solve the simultaneous equations for x and r.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution includes a check that the units of the final expressions are correct (meters).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly stating the work done by resistance as positive work, or omitting it from the work-energy equation.

title: Incorrect centripetal force expression
description: Pitfall: Using sin θ or cos θ incorrectly in the force balance for the banked curve (e.g., writing N sin θ = mv²/r without establishing N cos θ = mg).
